answer_1.quote: We evaluate the FLIRT framework by conducting experiments for text-to-image models... we use a text-to-text model as our target model and demonstrate the effectiveness of FLIRT in this setting as well.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating adversarial prompts to trigger unsafe content in text-to-image and text-to-text models, which is a form of natural language generation aimed at red teaming.
